answer.reason: The verses tell two events of Shishak: receiving the fugitive Jeroboam, and attacking Jerusalem and plundering its treasures.

clauses.english: took in Jeroboam when he fled from Solomon
clauses.quote: Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt

clauses.english: came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the temple and the king's house
clauses.quote: Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD
